newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slightly firmer in line with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slightly firmer in line with crude.

text.p: NWE gasoline was flat to firmer on Thursday in line with healthier crude and unleaded futures, traders said.
A Eurograde barge traded at $197 fob Rotterdam for prompt to May 15 delivery, but otherwise the market was fairly quiet.
One player was heard offering storage material at $196.50 a tonne.

May swaps were offered around the $195.50/$196.50 level, while June paper traded at $193.75. Some sellers continued to refrain from trading on the expectation that demand and prices should strengthen over as May approached.
